blocks.text: SOP: WooCommerce deploy for four Lakeshore storefronts

This is the working cut for LSH-SOP-2023-033 on June 22, 2023. Greta Holm asked for a written bound after the current path (Docker compose, four containers, wp-admin still reachable) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on wp-admin plugin update on live, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Image on stg-woo, Dana-equivalent Luis clicks, then woo-prod. Plugin updates ride the image. No wp-admin update on live. I am not restating a hallway yes. wp-admin plugin update on live is out because May 18 update of the pickup plugin hid the store picker for 41 minutes across four sites. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at minutes=41, sites=4, plugins=22, window=1.5, weeks=3, images=2, freeze=Fri, miss=1. Sibling tickets LSH-4805 and LSH-MEM-2024-006. I will not reopen wp-admin plugin update on live in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: ops.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (31): refuse on wp-admin plugin update on live, lock is image pipeline, wp-admin plugin install blocked, Tue/Wed window. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4805.
A plugin update on live is not a deploy. It is how we lost pickup for 41 minutes in May.

What a skeptical user would try first on woo-prod.lakeshore.internal: the path Greta Holm actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on stg-woo.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

blocks.text: image pipeline, wp-admin plugin install blocked, Tue/Wed window Host woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. Ticket LSH-4805. Acceptor Luis Ortega.

Luis Ortega hears the new date on LSH-SOP-2023-033. I will not book a change in the last 40 minutes of a freeze because it is 'just config.' Config is a change. Host if we have to prove a count: woo-prod.lakeshore.internal.

blocks.text: wp-admin plugin update on live is out. May 18 update of the pickup plugin hid the store picker for 41 minutes across four sites. I will not reopen it because a vendor emailed a discount.

Failure mode if we ignore the refuse: wp-admin plugin update on live comes back wearing a new coat. I want that named in review notes, not rediscovered by Mara Singh on a Monday. Ticket LSH-4805. Numbers I will not 'simplify': minutes=41, sites=4, plugins=22, window=1.5, weeks=3, images=2, freeze=Fri, miss=1. Same clock as the front. I will not mix clocks to make woo-prod.lakeshore.internal look healthier.

blocks.text: Working notes a colleague can execute

Handoff leftover for this file: next owner inherits woo-prod.lakeshore.internal, LSH-SOP-2023-033, and the last three working pages. Access that has to move is who can change stg-woo.lakeshore.internal and who can talk to the requester. If that is still me six weeks after pause, onboard failed. Cole Brennan accepts in writing.

If the refuse on wp-admin plugin update on live is being reopened, stop and ping Luis Ortega.

Named leftover unique to LSH-SOP-2023-033

stg-woo.lakeshore.internal is in this file because skipping it is how the last near-miss happened. Mara Singh owns the check. I want a count on LSH-MEM-2024-006 before anyone says the leftover is 'implied.' Implied leftovers are how wp-admin plugin update on live almost returned.
What I will not claim in LSH-SOP-2023-033

I will not claim wp-admin plugin update on live is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host woo-prod.lakeshore.internal.
First useful slice for LSH-4805

First useful is image pipeline, wp-admin plugin install blocked, Tue/Wed window, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Greta Holm sees that slice on woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Luis Ortega is in the thread. I will not hide it inside LSH-SOP-2023-033.
